FRAME 1 — THE LAST BUS. The Last Bus set, animated-cel register. Master 1640x2048, 4:5 portrait.

SCENE — on the pavement at standing height, looking west along Oxford Street toward Oxford Circus, the ghost bus in the near lane. OXFORD STREET: the wide wet roadway running from the foreground to Oxford Circus, empty of traffic. ROUTEMASTER: the ghost bus in the near lane, a 1956 London Transport Routemaster, its rear open platform level with the pavement. DEPARTMENT STORE WINDOWS: the long lit shop windows along the right-hand pavement, mannequins posed inside. BUS STOP: a temporary bus stop on the left-hand pavement, its timetable blank. PEDESTRIANISATION WORKS: barriers, exposed paving and a row of new bollards along the left-hand kerb.

STAGING — the Conductor: stands inside the bus's open rear platform recess with both boots on the platform floor at pavement level, one white-gloved hand on the vertical grab pole, the other raised with the brass ticket punch; the red body of the bus frames him on both sides; his porcelain mask catches the sodium light; the long coat tails hang still; he looks down the pavement toward Wyatt [ROUTEMASTER — inside the bus's open rear platform recess at pavement level, midground frame-right, the bus roof rising high above him; gaze on Wyatt]

STAGING — Akane, in the black wool coat over black high-neck dress with red scarf; never the black cardigan, white t-shirt, black cargo trousers and black wool overcoat; never the black tee, black jeans and black wool overcoat: leans against the department-store window with her right hand tucked under her left arm and her left hand resting on her right sleeve, one eyebrow raised, watching the bus with heavy-lidded boredom; the deep-red scarf draped loosely around her throat, one end hanging [DEPARTMENT STORE WINDOWS — midground frame-right, under the store awning; gaze on the Conductor, with utter boredom]

STAGING — Lucy, in the black tee, black jeans and black wool overcoat; never the black cardigan, white t-shirt, black cargo trousers and black wool overcoat; never the black wool coat over black high-neck dress with red scarf: holds a small black notebook open in her right hand and a pencil in her left, looking up at the bus's black destination blind, her coat collar up, one foot on the bus stop's kerb [BUS STOP — foreground frame-left at the bus stop; gaze on the bus's black destination blind]

STAGING — Wyatt, in the black cardigan, white t-shirt, black cargo trousers and black wool overcoat; never the black tee, black jeans and black wool overcoat; never the black wool coat over black high-neck dress with red scarf: stands between the bus and the others, left arm extended sideways at waist height, palm open — a barrier — his right hand loose at his side, masked face tilted up toward the rear platform [OXFORD STREET — foreground, a step into the roadway between the bus and the others; gaze on the Conductor]

STAGING — Cyndi: stands rigid at Lucy's heels, nose lifted high scenting the wet street toward the bus, ears pricked, tail low and still [BUS STOP — low in frame at Lucy's heels; gaze on the Conductor]

PROP — routemaster: a 1956 London Transport Routemaster in deep bus red, seen from the rear: a rounded roof, a deep open rear platform recess with a step, a vertical grab pole from floor to ceiling and a staircase behind it; the destination blind black with a single white ring; a small black rear route blind above the open platform shows the same single white ring; warm amber interior lights behind steamed windows; through the rear lower window the pale blank face and shoulders of one seated mannequin are clearly visible, the others dark shapes behind it; the Conductor stands inside the open platform recess; the driver's cab dark and empty; the bus is a solid prop vehicle standing on its wheels [owner: the Conductor; anchor: ROUTEMASTER]

STATE — routemaster: the bus is silent, its engine off, its interior lights on; the mannequin passengers sit inside, one pale blank face visible through the rear lower window; the driver's seat bare; the white ring on the rear route blind is the only mark; the Conductor's boots are on the platform floor inside the recess

PROP — mannequin passengers: six display mannequins, jointed wooden-and-plaster figures with blank faces, dressed in 2026 high-street coats, seated upright, each holding a closed black umbrella [owner: the Conductor; anchor: ROUTEMASTER]

STATE — mannequin passengers: the mannequins are display figures sitting perfectly still, their blank faces turned slightly toward the windows

PROP — ticket punch: a heavy brass bus conductor's ticket punch on a chain, its jaws open [owner: the Conductor; anchor: ROUTEMASTER]

PROP — notebook: a small black pocket notebook, open, its pages blank; a pencil in her left hand [owner: Lucy; anchor: BUS STOP]

MOMENT — The last night buses have gone; the street is empty except for a Routemaster with a black blind and a white ring. The Conductor raises his punch. In the department-store windows, the mannequins seem to turn. Wyatt steps into the road.

ENVIRONMENT INVENTORY: Oxford Street at one in the morning: wet charcoal asphalt, closed shopfronts, long department-store windows lit from within, a temporary bus stop pole on the left pavement topped by a blank white disc atop a plain pole, a row of stubby black bollards along the near left kerb with their bases ringed by temporary yellow tape, blank grey barrier panels stacked behind them, a single street sweeper's cart far down the pavement, the Routemaster the only vehicle in motion; the store windows are full of mannequins in 2026 coats; every surface plain and unlettered, with blank hoardings.

LIGHTING: sodium-amber street lamps and cold blue night; the bus's warm amber interior glowing through steamed windows; wet asphalt doubling the lights; the Conductor's porcelain mask lit from below by the bus; long shadows across the empty lane.

COLOUR: full colour — charcoal wet asphalt, sodium amber, deep London bus red, warm amber interior; Akane's deep-red scarf the only other red; the rest of the palette near-monochrome.

NEGATIVES: destination blinds, timetables, tickets, shop signs and badges are plain blank panels of colour; the Routemaster is a 1956 London Transport bus: half-cab front, open rear platform, curved roof and chrome-trimmed livery; the bus is a solid prop vehicle standing on its wheels, opaque painted metal; the mannequins are jointed display figures with blank featureless faces and bare fibreglass joints; the bus cab is dark and empty, its driver's seat bare; clean costumes, undamaged props and safe set dressing throughout; Akane's hands stay busy in her lap or at her sides; Wyatt's hands are clean bare skin, his only tattoos the king and queen on his neck; Wyatt's mask is a smooth matte-black shield covering his whole face from hairline to chin, its surface plain black with two round eye holes; the Conductor's porcelain mask is a blank white oval with a single punched circular hole near the chin, its surface otherwise smooth blank porcelain; the white porcelain mask belongs to the Conductor, the black mask to Wyatt; the white porcelain mask belongs to the Conductor, the black mask to Wyatt; Akane is an adult woman, her deep-red scarf a loose silk neck scarf draped at the throat; Cyndi is a tan Belgian Malinois-type shepherd with a black muzzle, erect ears, dark eyes, a lean athletic build and a short coat; the bus stop is a plain pole carrying a blank white disc; the Conductor's boots are planted on the platform floor inside the open rear recess; the upper half of the Conductor's white mask is pure blank porcelain, evenly lit.

THE CONDUCTOR (verbatim block): The Conductor is a tall, narrow figure about 196cm high: a black London Transport bus conductor's double-breasted coat with silver buttons, a high collar and long skirts to the ankle; a white shirt and black tie; black trousers with a thin red side stripe; raised black leather boots; white cotton gloves; and a tall black peaked cap with a polished patent visor and a blank oval badge. The face is a smooth porcelain oval mask the colour of a blank ticket, its only opening a single clean circular punch hole where the mouth would sit, and its surface blank ticket-white everywhere beyond that — plainly a theatrical costume mask. A heavy brass ticket punch hangs from a chain at the belt. It is a person in a bus conductor's costume: a solid figure standing on its own feet, the coat dense opaque wool, dressed for a harmless theatrical fright.

AKANE (verbatim block): Akane is a petite Japanese woman, 153cm tall and 5 heads in proportion, with pale porcelain skin, blue eyes, and long black hair worn mostly straight with loose waves at the ends and a full straight fringe across her forehead. Her legs are natural in length and proportion, in keeping with her five-head build. She carries herself with the manner of a temptress — a heavy-lidded, knowing gaze, languid and magnetic, self-assured, arms folded or one hand on her hip, her hands busy and active at her hip or her sides. She is self-contained and absorbed in her own action, with a lively, expressive face. She is rendered in a painterly cel style, more softly modelled than flat cel animation.

AKANE'S OUTFIT — akane.oxford_night: a black wool wrap coat worn open over a black ribbed-knit long-sleeve dress with a high neck and a deep-red silk scarf draped loosely around her throat, one end hanging; sheer black tights; black fur-trim horsebit loafers; a gold Cartier Love bangle on her right wrist and a gold Rolex with a deep green dial on her left wrist.

LUCY (verbatim block): Lucy is a Puerto Rican woman with a wide, slightly flattened oval face, a defined angular jawline softer at the cheeks, a light dusting of freckles across her nose and cheeks, and skin in a light warm tan. Her eyes are large vertical ovals with green irises and a heavy lower lash line: the lid line sweeps smoothly from inner to outer corner, and each iris fills its opening with clear green. She is 5 feet 4 inches tall with a very slim, willowy build — narrow shoulders and ribcage, a small waist, slim hips, thin arms and long legs (inseam about 48% of her height, natural waist at about 60%) — and a full, generous F bust. Her hair is long loose waves to mid-back, centre-parted, black with graphic sculptural clumps. Everything she wears is black and white; coral is her design signature — it lives in her work as ink and paper, while her skin and face stay clean, bare and untouched.

LUCY'S OUTFIT — lucy.oxford_night: a plain black t-shirt tucked into black jeans, a black wool overcoat worn open, white socks, plain black leather loafers, her two gold hoop earrings.

WYATT (verbatim block): Wyatt is an adult man in flat painterly cel animation, drawn EXACTLY as in his cel reference sheet — the same man. He is 153cm tall and exactly 5 heads in proportion: his head, hair and mask together are one fifth of his height, with a grown man's construction throughout and legs about half his height. His hair is voluminous black curls, medium length. On his neck sit two portrait tattoos facing inward toward the throat: a crowned bearded KING on his left side, and a crowned QUEEN — a woman — on his right.

WYATT'S MASK (verbatim, mandatory): The mask is a tall smooth shield of matte black covering his whole face in one piece, from the hairline above his brow down past his jaw and chin, edge to edge across both cheeks. Its surface is plain matte black throughout. It carries two round holes, one at each eye, and those two holes are its only openings: each one opens onto flat empty blackness. The mask reads as a single unbroken black form from forehead to chin, with both round eye holes always present and open.

WYATT'S OUTFIT — wyatt.oxford_night: a black knit button cardigan (5 buttons, patch pockets) worn open over a plain white crew-neck t-shirt; black cargo trousers with side flap pockets; a black wool overcoat worn open over the cardigan; black Adidas Samba sneakers with white side stripes, gum-brown soles and a small blue heel tab.

CYNDI (verbatim block): Cyndi is a lean, athletic medium-sized mixed-breed dog with a short uniform golden-tan coat, a long muzzle that is BLACK with a little grey around the mouth, large upright pointed ears with dark backs, dark brown eyes, a small white patch on her chest and white tips on her paws, and a straight medium-length tail carried low with a dark tip. Her build is that of a grown athletic mixed breed with normal leg length for her size: a long straight tail, a lean foxy muzzle and a short smooth coat, exactly the adult dog shown in her attached reference images.

SCALE: the Conductor is 196cm — the tallest in this frame; Lucy (163cm), Akane (153cm), Wyatt (153cm), Cyndi (58cm).
Akane and Wyatt stand at exactly the same height (153cm).

The black wool coat over black high-neck dress with red scarf appears exactly once in this frame, on Akane.

The black tee, black jeans and black wool overcoat appears exactly once in this frame, on Lucy.

The black cardigan, white t-shirt, black cargo trousers and black wool overcoat appears exactly once in this frame, on Wyatt.

RENDER GRADE — ANIMATED (verbatim in every frame): Flat painterly cel animation — bold clean ink outlines, flat colour fills with soft cel shading, the look of a hand-drawn animated feature film: a classic cartoon mystery adventure retold as an animated film still. Cinematic composition, dramatic motivated lighting rendered in cel tones. 4:5 portrait composition. Absolutely no text, no lettering, no captions, no logos and no watermark anywhere in the image.
